0.content: Amber's grandfather once led a mercenary company in Liyue Harbor, escorting merchant caravans. When monsters wiped out one caravan, he was the sole survivor, saved by a Knights of Favonius doctor. Ashamed to go home and wanting to repay the debt, he joined the Knights. He founded the Outriders, trained every member personally, married in Mondstadt and raised a family. Moved by his granddaughter's secret practice, he taught her everything he knew: "When Mondstadt accepted me, it became my homeland." Four years before the Traveler arrived, just after Amber joined the Outriders, he left his sword and coat of arms in his office and disappeared without a note.

1.content: The Outriders were the Knights of Favonius' scouting team of archers, famed for tracking and for sensing danger. Since its founder left, the team has been a shell, kept for its structure and name, with Amber its only member. She patrols the outskirts, meets newcomers first, escorts travellers and clears monster camps. Outriders also use wind gliders, and Amber issues gliding licenses.

2.content: Eula, Captain of the Reconnaissance Company and a descendant of the disgraced Lawrence Clan, is Amber's closest friend. They were friends long before Eula joined the Knights; Eula was the beloved student of Amber's grandfather, and Amber trusts her completely. Amber cleaned Eula's dorm and gave her a tour on her first day, runs her errands, and gets shopkeepers to charge her normal prices. Eula grumbles that everyone now treats her like an older sibling who needs a younger one to do everything, and vows that Amber "must pay" for it. Amber insists Eula is only misunderstood because of her family name and her sense of humour.

3.content: "I joined the Knights because of my grandpa, I stayed because of Jean." Amber trusts the Acting Grand Master absolutely; in the Prologue she told the Traveler that everything would be fine with Jean on their side. She frets that Jean carries every burden, wants to invite her for coffee (Jean's coffee is Amber's favourite) and fears Jean catching her lazing about. Jean says Amber's recent growth impresses her and hopes her deeds will one day be sung by bards.

4.content: In the official manga, set less than a year before the Traveler arrived, Collei came to Mondstadt hostile and frightened. Amber befriended her despite her warnings, helped her search, and took her to Ludi Harpastum to show her people living happily. When she learned Collei was behind the Black Fire Incident, she chose to help anyway and kept guard while Cyno sealed Collei's power. Collei calls Amber the person she admires most, "like a cozy fire", and traces her archery practice back to a Ludi Harpastum night with her; her first clumsy sewing was a repair of Amber's old clothes. They correspond by letter; Amber was overjoyed to hear that Collei's Eleazar was cured.

5.content: Prologue (1.0). As the Traveler and Paimon left the Whispering Woods, Amber leapt into their path, gave a handbook greeting and demanded they explain themselves, calling Paimon a "mascot". Hearing the Traveler sought a lost sibling, she offered to help with posters. She had them help clear a hilichurl camp, then welcomed them to the city of wind, dandelions and freedom and gave them a wind glider, explaining that "the wind is the heart and soul of Mondstadt". She promised Paimon a Sticky Honey Roast.

6.comment: Amber: The Gliding License and Raptor
6.content: In her Story Quest (Lepus Chapter, 1.0) Amber examined the Traveler for a gliding license and accidentally handed them her childhood storybook instead of the manual. The examiner admitted the real manual was too dry for her and that the fable had truly taught her to glide. When Sir Otto mistook the Traveler for an accomplice of the thief Raptor, Amber joined the hunt and made the last exam stage a gliding assault on Raptor's hideout. At a chasm, Raptor mocked "the little girl". She jumped anyway ("The wind says I WILL make it"), caught a current she could not have seen from the ground, and arrested him. She then confessed her own license had been revoked so often she had sat the exam about fifteen times, and signed the Traveler up for the next championship so she would finally have competition.

7.content: Amber's handmade rabbit-eared doll, which taunts enemies into attacking it and then explodes. She says the line has run past "Baron Bunny the 893rd". Klee loves it because it explodes, and Sucrose objects that it looks nothing like a rabbit. Amber taught Noelle to make one, and Noelle carries it for luck (it does not explode). She also gifts friends custom versions, promising they will not blow up. Its design is based on her Outrider uniform.
